name: CupertinoActionSheetAction
description: An iOS-style action button used inside a CupertinoActionSheet. Typically represents a single action option like 'Delete', 'Share', or 'Edit'.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The content of the action button, typically a Text widget.

properties.name: onPressed
properties.description: Callback function executed when the action is pressed.

properties.name: isDefaultAction
properties.description: Whether this action is the default (highlighted) action.

properties.name: isDestructiveAction
properties.description: Whether this action indicates a destructive operation (e.g., delete).

properties.name: key
properties.description: An optional identifier for this widget.
